scope: ThreeUI, Amicro, Anatomy and seven article/post leads

items.name: Anatomy
items.finding: An isometric laboratory scene combining SVG apparatus and WebGL water patterns for wave-interference explainers. Reuse the Node build script, light or dark page, and frequency/spacing controls. Adapt the model, labels, and interaction sequence; add browser recording or a controlled video timeline and audio. The example outputs HTML, not an MP4.

items.name: Amicro
items.finding: Lines slide upward through clipped masks with a staggered reveal for titles, feature statements, and chapter cards. Reuse the React component and its duration and stagger controls. It uses Framer Motion and viewport-triggered playback; add browser recording or replace the trigger with frame-based timing for video rendering.

items.name: 代码视频六层母版提示词
items.finding: A Chinese article with a complete reusable production prompt covering deliverables, creative choices, technical constraints, visual rules, a central idea, and review iterations. Useful for briefing agent-made explainers or product films; replace the topic, format, and creative direction. It supplies instructions rather than a fixed visual style or executable template.

items.name: ThreeUI
items.finding: Reviewed Community README, asset terms and TextAnimationCollection source. Free React typography variants exist; Pro/Beta source is excluded and remote previews are outside the repository license. Select and review one full renderer and its video timing/capture mechanism before admission.

items.name: SVG 分层与描边动画
items.review_method: Saved article body reviewed; live retrieval unavailable or empty
items.finding: Saved article describes staggered SVG layers and stroke-dashoffset technique, and points to existing Paper-Cut and map-motion projects. No complete standalone SVG animation template was identified in the saved body. Keep as a technique lead, not a duplicate of those projects.

items.name: SVG 科普图形提示词模板
items.review_method: Saved article body reviewed; live retrieval unavailable or empty
items.finding: Saved article contains complete graphic prompts and a static SVG card example. Static illustrations are useful inputs but require a timeline and rendering workflow before admission as video templates.

items.name: 三维地图纹理工作流
items.review_method: Saved article body reviewed; live retrieval unavailable or empty
items.finding: Saved article documents DataV SVG to Blender extrusion, generated textures and Three.js assembly. It explicitly leaves animation and other integration work for later; no complete reusable video project established.

items.name: 4K 宣传片代码剪辑案例
items.review_method: Saved article body reviewed; live retrieval unavailable or empty
items.finding: Saved article describes a production case, not a downloadable complete film template. Found original presentation and author-post links; presentation retrieval exceeded the web tool size limit. Verify primary artifacts and their availability before admission.

items.name: HTML 动态交互组件提示词模板
items.review_method: Saved article body reviewed; live retrieval unavailable or empty
items.finding: Saved article contains a complete prompt for interactive HTML components, including a thunder example. It specifies UI states and feedback but no fixed video timeline or export contract; retain as a supporting technique lead.

items.name: Remotion 孟菲斯风格终端演示
items.review_method: Saved article body reviewed; live retrieval unavailable or empty
items.finding: Saved post contains prompts for Memphis-colored terminal typing, an expanding page transition and inserted video. Its links point to Remotion and official skills, already listed; no complete scene source was identified. User-supplied command logs and footage are still required.
